title: A Fighter Pilot’s Career and the Future of Air Combat
gist: Episode notes for an Airman Pulse podcast in which Rob Trsek interviews retired Brig. Gen. Robert Novotny, a 28-year F-15 pilot who last commanded the 57th Wing at Nellis AFB, about his career, his move into the defense industry, and where he thinks fighter aviation is headed. The notes give no substantive views from the episode itself.

insights.claim: Retired Air Force Brig. Gen. Robert Novotny, a career F-15 pilot who commanded at every level over 28 years and finished as commander of the 57th Wing at Nellis Air Force Base, discusses his career and the future of fighter aviation on the Airman Pulse podcast.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Members-only episode may hold practitioner views on future air combat relevant to fighter programs; notes alone give no thesis.

insights.claim: Novotny moved from Air Force service into the defense industry after retiring.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Illustrates the senior-officer pipeline into defense contractors.
